newsitem.title: USA: No big GDP impact from US Feb trade -- Commerce.
newsitem.headline: No big GDP impact from US Feb trade -- Commerce.

text.p: Commerce undersecretary Everett Ehrlich said on Thursday that February U.S. trade data would not have a major impact on first-quarter gross domestic product figures.
In an interview with Reuters Financial Television, Ehrlich said the trade data, which showed unexpected strength in U.S. imports, would not "change the character" of GDP data.
He said first-quarter GDP is likely to be "around the vicinity" of four percent.
Ehrlich maintained that the level of the dollar was not a major factor affecting the trade data. "I dont think the dollar is what's driving the numbers," he said.
Ehrlich also emphasized the need for faster growth and more deregulation in the Japanese economy.
"We need to see faster growth in Japan," Ehrlich said. "We need to see greater deregulation and more openness and that will create the conditions for faster growth."
